title: Admiral Grace Hopper Explains the Nanosecond
summary: Admiral Grace Hopper holds up a length of wire to show how far light travels in a nanosecond, about 11.8 inches. She explains how she made the idea concrete to people who could not picture a billionth of a second.
why: HN uses it to illustrate physical latency limits and why performance and distance matter in computing.
topic: latency and the speed of light
